system.description:
Boosts Defence Combat Value when avoiding ranged attacks under a specific condition, such on foot or piloting a vehicle.
Level 1: +2 DCV against ranged attacks under a specific condition
Level 2: +4 DCV against ranged attacks under a specific condition
Level 3: +6 DCV against ranged attacks under a specific condition
Level 4: +8 DCV against ranged attacks under a specific condition
Level 5: +10 DCV against ranged attacks under a specific condition
Level 6: +12 DCV against ranged attacks under a specific condition
